bagPolicy.summary: Bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches are permitted and will be searched before entry. Non-clear bags may receive additional inspection.
allowed: bags up to 12 x 6 x 12 inches
prohibited: bags larger than 12 x 6 x 12 inches
bagPolicy.note: All bags are subject to search; event restrictions may be stricter.

parking.note: There is limited metered street parking near the venue. Commercial lots are available on 5th and Bainbridge Streets, but they accept cash only. The venue has partnered with ParkWhiz for additional parking options.

rideshare.note: Drop-off in front of the building is allowed for all guests.

concessions.note: The Theatre of Living Arts offers an eclectic mix of beers, wines, spirits, and non-alcoholic beverages. Snack options include popcorn, soft pretzels, chips, and candy, available at the bar.

accessibility.title: Accessibility
accessibility.body: The Theatre of Living Arts's dedicated accessible entrance is located at 334 South Street. The Theatre of Living Arts's dedicated accessible entrance is located at 334 South Street.

reEntry.title: Re-Entry Policy
reEntry.body: Re-entry is not allowed. Once you leave the venue, you cannot come back in.

ticketPickup.title: Box Office & Ticket Pickup
ticketPickup.body: The box office is at 334 South Street on the front of the venue and opens two hours before doors on show days only; it takes Visa, MasterCard, and cash. For will call, bring photo ID and the card used to buy. All events are mobile entry, and tickets aren't emailed or printable.

gates.title: Gates & Entrances
gates.body: Doors generally open about one hour before the scheduled show time. Confirm the exact door time on the event listing or ticket.
